videos.description_1: Upload your Excel schedule and SiteNear will build an editable Gantt chart. Adjust progress anytime while viewing the baseline plan and current schedule side by side.
videos.description_2: Open a project to create work items, organize the workflow by trade, and add due-date reminders and material notes.
videos.title_3: How to pin tasks on a floor plan
videos.description_3: While supervising work on site, place each task at its actual location on the floor plan. Add multiple pins when one task spans several areas.

videos.description_1: Excel 甘特圖上傳後，系統會自動建立可編輯的甘特圖，讓你隨時調整進度並同時查看規劃與施工兩條時間軸。
videos.description_2: 進入專案後即可建立施工代辦任務，依工程類型安排工序並設定時間提醒與材料備註。
videos.title_3: 如何將待辦任務註記在圖面
videos.description_3: 現場監工時更直覺地對應實際空間位置。並滿足同一任務建立多處標註。
